title: Steppenwolf
author: Hermann Hesse
summary: Harry Haller, a middle-aged intellectual who thinks of himself as half man and half wolf, is out of tune with the modern world. Through a chance meeting, he is drawn into a strange series of encounters, including a magic theatre.
readIf: you like strange, philosophical novels about alienation and inner division.
skipIf: you want a straightforward story, since the second half becomes surreal.

pairings.reason: The author's calmer, more hopeful book about finding peace.
Another short novel about a man estranged from himself and the world around him.
A modern, dreamlike novel in which the real and the strange blur.
